subLocations.name: The Smilin' Boar
subLocations.lore: One of Bloomridge's most trendy eateries, serving bawdier versions of traditional morningfeast dishes such as "[[sow's delight]]" and "[[three pigs in a blanket]]", and [[coffee]] and [[tea]] was served in mugs that were shaped like a [[pig]]'s head.

subLocations.name: Blushing Mermaid
subLocations.lore: A famous lower-class tavern that provided drinks and food and was known for its shady associations, rumors of secret smuggling passages, and hidden vaults underneath.

subLocations.name: Elfsong Tavern
subLocations.lore: A well-known tavern famed for its singing [[ghost]], [[Elfsong Cider|cider]], and a stuffed baby [[beholder]].

subLocations.name: Low Lantern
subLocations.lore: A three-mast ship converted to be used as a [[festhall]], tavern, and gambling house.

subLocations.name: Jopalin's
subLocations.lore: Once a seedy tavern serving sailors, turned into a [[tea]] and [[coffee]]-sipping cafe after such establishments became popular in the 15{{th}} century [[DR]].

subLocations.name: Garmult's House of Mastery
subLocations.lore: An academy that specialized in tutoring pupils on how to improve their martial prowess and combat skills and a social club for the members of the [[Bannerless Legion]] crew.

subLocations.name: Undercellar's Main Entrance
subLocations.lore: A clump of chambers in a network of storage cellars beneath [[Baldur's Gate]] that housed a sleazy tavern and [[festhall]]; there existed at least twenty-four ways in and out of this popular establishment, half of which connected to other buildings.

subLocations.name: House of the Lute
subLocations.lore: A modest [[kaeth]] house and [[minstrel]]s' gallery that offered classes from master musicians to its customers.

subLocations.name: The House of the Lion
subLocations.lore: An opulent festhall that counted "blades" and "lacethroats"  – youths of money and means, among its patrons.

subLocations.name: The Singing Lute
subLocations.lore: A small tavern and an eatery that offered local brews and a grumpy proprietor.{{approx}}

subLocations.name: Sharess' Caress
subLocations.lore: A 15{{th}} century [[DR]] [[festhall]] where one could find consorts, musicians, drinks, food, lodgings, and more thematic coinlassess who catered to specific tastes.{{approx}}
